The '''"Firestorm" under-barrel flame projector''' was a [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] kit available following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The kit was produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] and cost 3000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTE" />
